newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-West Indies win toss, Western Australia to bat.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-West Indies win toss, Western Australia to bat.

text.p: West Indies won the toss and asked Western Australia to bat in an unscheduled limited overs match on Thursday in Perth.
The match was organised during one of a number of rain delays in a shortened match between the two sides on Wednesday. Western Australia won that match by nine wickets.
Reserve wicketkeeper Junior Murray and opening batsman Sherwin Campbell come into the West Indies side in place of Robert Samuels and Courtney Browne.
West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Adrian Griffith, Brian Lara (captain), Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Roland Holder, Junior Murray, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Nixon McLean.
Western Australia - Mark Lavender, Mike Hussey, Damien Martyn, Justin Langer, Rob Baker, Ryan Campbell, Brendon Julian (captain), Kade Harvey, Mark Atkinson, Jamie Stewart, Sean Cary.
